#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compose editable GIS with the maintained Operator; preserve unrelated source edits."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile

MODEL_FILES = ('gis_project.py', 'gis_workspace.py', 'gis_project_cli.py',
               'gis_project_native.py', 'gis_project_view.html', 'GIS_PROJECTS.md', 'requirements-gis.txt')
OWN_FILES = tuple('model/' + x for x in MODEL_FILES) + (
    'operator/gis_projects.py', 'operator/web/gis-projects.mjs', 'operator/web/gis-projects.css',
    'operator/extensions/gis-projects.json')
MARKER = '# Editable GIS integration: ASTRA-GIS12/v1'


def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()


def once(text, old, new, label):
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Original source seam differs: ' + label + '. Compose against its current owner revision.')
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


def server_source(text):
    if MARKER in text:
        return text
    text = once(text, 'class Operator:', MARKER + '\nfrom gis_projects import ACTIONS as GIS_ACTIONS, GISProjects\nACTIONS = set(ACTIONS) | GIS_ACTIONS\n\nclass Operator:', 'Operator declaration')
    # Select _invoke structurally; other extensions can use their own action local.
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    cls = next(x for x in tree.body if isinstance(x, ast.ClassDef) and x.name == 'Operator')
    fn = next(x for x in cls.body if isinstance(x, ast.FunctionDef) and x.name == '_invoke')
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    body = ''.join(lines[fn.lineno - 1:fn.end_lineno])
    body = once(body, '        action = task["action"]\n', '        action = task["action"]\n        if action in GIS_ACTIONS:\n            return GISProjects(self).invoke(task)\n', '_invoke action')
    text = ''.join(lines[:fn.lineno - 1]) + body + ''.join(lines[fn.end_lineno:])
    # Existing review/task decorators remain the terminal writer.
    text = once(text, '        return self.customer_reviews.decorate_task(task)',
                '        task = GISProjects(self).decorate_task(task)\n        return self.customer_reviews.decorate_task(task)', 'task_view decorator')
    old = '            if url.path.startswith("/api/file/"):\n'
    new = '''            if url.path.startswith("/api/file/gis-project/"):
                self.authorized(file=True)
                parts = url.path.removeprefix("/api/file/gis-project/").split("/", 3)
                if len(parts) != 4:
                    raise ValueError("Choose an original GIS project member")
                ticket, policy = GISProjects(self.app).member(*[urllib.parse.unquote(x) for x in parts])
                return self.send_file(ticket["id"], download=one("download") == "1", content_security_policy=policy)
'''+old
    text = once(text, old, new, 'original file routing')
    old = '                workspace = one("workspace", self.app.primary)\n'
    text = once(text, old, old + '                if url.path == "/api/gis/projects":\n                    return self.send_json(200, GISProjects(self.app).catalogue(workspace))\n', 'original authorized GET workspace')
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    selected = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Compare) and
                isinstance(n.left, ast.Name) and n.left.id == 'selected' and
                len(n.ops) == 1 and isinstance(n.ops[0], ast.NotIn) and
                isinstance(n.comparators[0], ast.Set) and
                any(isinstance(e, ast.Constant) and e.value == 'app.mjs' for e in n.comparators[0].elts)]
    if len(selected) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Original browser asset admission changed')
    node = selected[0].comparators[0]
    rows = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    before = sum(len(x.encode('utf-8')) for x in rows[:node.end_lineno - 1]) + node.end_col_offset - 1
    raw = text.encode('utf-8')
    text = (raw[:before] + b', "gis-projects.mjs", "gis-projects.css"' + raw[before:]).decode('utf-8')
    ast.parse(text)
    return text


def browser_source(text):
    if "import {attachGISProjects}" in text:
        return text
    text = "import {attachGISProjects} from './gis-projects.mjs';\n" + text
    text = once(text, 'const viewLabels={', "const viewLabels={'gis-projects':'Editable GIS projects',", 'view names')
    text = once(text, 'const actionLabels={', "const actionLabels={'gis.project.export':'Build editable GIS project','gis.project.receive':'Receive editable GIS project','gis.project.adopt-sources':'Adopt received GIS sources',", 'action names')
    text = once(text, 'function toast(message){', "const gisProjects=attachGISProjects({getState:()=>state,api,refreshState:refresh,showTask,toast});\nfunction toast(message){", 'original UI factory')
    text = once(text, '    renderTasks();\n', '    renderTasks();\n    gisProjects.update(data);\n', 'retained state refresh')
    seam="  if(view==='spatial'){"
    text = once(text, seam, "  if(view==='gis-projects'){community.detach();customerReviews.detach();spatialWorkspace.suspend();gisProjects.mount($('#content'),state);return;}\n  gisProjects.detach();\n" + seam, 'original view lifecycle')
    return text


def index_source(text):
    if 'data-view="gis-projects"' in text:
        return text
    seam='<link rel="stylesheet" href="/web/reviews.css">'
    text=once(text,seam,seam+'\n  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/web/gis-projects.css">','original stylesheet list')
    seam='<button data-view="runs">Native model runs</button>'
    return once(text,seam,seam+'\n    <button data-view="gis-projects">Editable GIS projects</button>','original navigation')



def legacy_server_source(text):
    """Remove only the exact former GIS-owned joins before shared registration."""
    if MARKER not in text:
        return text
    text = once(text, MARKER + '\nfrom gis_projects import ACTIONS as GIS_ACTIONS, GISProjects\nACTIONS = set(ACTIONS) | GIS_ACTIONS\n\n', '', 'legacy GIS provider')
    text = once(text, '        if action in GIS_ACTIONS:\n            return GISProjects(self).invoke(task)\n', '', 'legacy GIS dispatch')
    text = once(text, '        task = GISProjects(self).decorate_task(task)\n', '', 'legacy GIS task decoration')
    text = once(text, '''            if url.path.startswith("/api/file/gis-project/"):
                self.authorized(file=True)
                parts = url.path.removeprefix("/api/file/gis-project/").split("/", 3)
                if len(parts) != 4:
                    raise ValueError("Choose an original GIS project member")
                ticket, policy = GISProjects(self.app).member(*[urllib.parse.unquote(x) for x in parts])
                return self.send_file(ticket["id"], download=one("download") == "1", content_security_policy=policy)
''', '', 'legacy GIS file route')
    text = once(text, '                if url.path == "/api/gis/projects":\n                    return self.send_json(200, GISProjects(self.app).catalogue(workspace))\n', '', 'legacy GIS catalogue')
    return once(text, ', "gis-projects.mjs", "gis-projects.css"', '', 'legacy GIS static assets')


def legacy_browser_source(text):
    if "import {attachGISProjects}" not in text:
        return text
    labels = (
        "const actionLabels={'gis.project.export':'Build editable GIS project','gis.project.receive':'Receive editable GIS project','gis.project.adopt-sources':'Adopt received GIS sources',",
        "const actionLabels={'gis.project.export':'Build editable GIS project','gis.project.receive':'Receive editable GIS project',",
    )
    old_labels = next((value for value in labels if value in text), None)
    if old_labels is None:
        raise ValueError('Compose the current GIS action labels before shared registration')
    for old, new, label in (
        ("import {attachGISProjects} from './gis-projects.mjs';\n", '', 'legacy GIS import'),
        ("const viewLabels={'gis-projects':'Editable GIS projects',", 'const viewLabels={', 'legacy GIS view'),
        (old_labels, 'const actionLabels={', 'legacy GIS actions'),
        ("const gisProjects=attachGISProjects({getState:()=>state,api,refreshState:refresh,showTask,toast});\n", '', 'legacy GIS controller'),
        ('    gisProjects.update(data);\n', '', 'legacy GIS refresh'),
        ("  if(view==='gis-projects'){community.detach();customerReviews.detach();spatialWorkspace.suspend();gisProjects.mount($('#content'),state);return;}\n  gisProjects.detach();\n", '', 'legacy GIS lifecycle'),
    ):
        text = once(text, old, new, label)
    return text


def legacy_index_source(text):
    for old in ('\n  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/web/gis-projects.css">',
                '\n    <button data-view="gis-projects">Editable GIS projects</button>'):
        if old in text:
            text = once(text, old, '', 'legacy GIS navigation or stylesheet')
    return text


def registration_plan(application):
    """Use the receiving application's maintained host, with one active GIS owner."""
    host = application / 'install_extensions.py'
    if not host.is_file():
        return ({'operator/server.py': server_source,
                 'operator/web/app.mjs': browser_source,
                 'operator/web/index.html': index_source}, None, 'legacy')
    if host.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError('The maintained extension installer is a symbolic link')
    registry = application / 'operator/extension_registry.py'
    if not registry.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Receive the current complete extension host with install_extensions.py')
    registry_body = registry.read_bytes()
    if b'def file_reply(' not in registry_body or b'def _member_path(' not in registry_body:
        raise ValueError('Receive the maintained extension host with nested member file routes')
    body = host.read_bytes()
    # This is an installed application module, never source supplied by a GIS ZIP.
    namespace = {'__name__': '_upstate_gis_current_extension_installer', '__file__': str(host)}
    exec(compile(body, str(host), 'exec'), namespace)
    if not callable(namespace.get('patch_server')) or not callable(namespace.get('patch_app')):
        raise ValueError('The current extension installer lacks its source composition API')
    transform = {
        'operator/server.py': lambda value: namespace['patch_server'](legacy_server_source(value)),
        'operator/web/app.mjs': lambda value: namespace['patch_app'](legacy_browser_source(value)),
        'operator/web/index.html': legacy_index_source,
    }
    return transform, {host: body, registry: registry_body}, 'registry'


def install(application, source, dry_run=False):
    application, source = Path(application).resolve(strict=True), Path(source).resolve(strict=True)
    if not (application / 'model/workspace.py').is_file():
        raise ValueError('Receive the original scientific application before this additive component')
    transform, dependencies, integration = registration_plan(application)
    before={};planned={}
    for name, fn in transform.items():
        path=application/name
        if path.is_symlink(): raise ValueError('Original registration file is a symbolic link')
        before[name]=path.read_bytes();planned[name]=fn(before[name].decode('utf-8')).encode('utf-8')
    for name in OWN_FILES:
        data=(source/name).read_bytes();target=application/name
        if target.is_symlink(): raise ValueError('Component destination is a symbolic link')
        before[name]=target.read_bytes() if target.exists() else None
        # This installer is intentionally the owner of these named additive files.
        planned[name]=data
    for name, data in planned.items():
        if name.endswith('.py'): compile(data,str(application/name),'exec')
    changes=[name for name in planned if planned[name]!=before[name]]
    result={'schema':'upstate.gis-installation/v1','application':str(application),'dry_run':dry_run,
            'integration':integration,
            'files':[{'path':name,'before_sha256':sha(before[name]) if before[name] is not None else None,
                      'sha256':sha(planned[name]),'bytes':len(planned[name])} for name in changes]}
    if dry_run or not changes:return result
    # A shared original owner can inspect/undo exact registration edits from this journal.
    journal=application/'source_tools'/'gis-installations'
    journal.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    operation=sha(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True).encode())
    record=journal/(operation+'.json')
    staged={};applied=[]
    try:
        for name in changes:
            path=application/name;path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent,prefix='.gis-install-',delete=False) as out:
                out.write(planned[name]);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno());staged[name]=Path(out.name)
        # Compare all predecessors immediately before committing any registration changes.
        for dependency, expected in (dependencies or {}).items():
            if dependency.read_bytes() != expected:
                raise ValueError('Concurrent extension host change: ' + str(dependency))
        for name in changes:
            p=application/name
            actual=p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else None
            if actual!=before[name]:raise ValueError('Concurrent original source change: '+name)
        for name in changes:
            p=application/name
            actual=p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else None
            if actual!=before[name]:raise ValueError('Concurrent original source change: '+name)
            if before[name] is not None:
                backup=journal/(operation+'-'+name.replace('/','__')+'.before')
                backup.write_bytes(before[name])
            os.replace(staged[name],p);applied.append(name)
        record.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    except BaseException:
        for name in reversed(applied):
            p=application/name
            if p.read_bytes()!=planned[name]:continue
            if before[name] is None:p.unlink()
            else:
                with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=p.parent,prefix='.gis-rollback-',delete=False) as out:
                    out.write(before[name]);out.flush();os.fsync(out.fileno());temporary=Path(out.name)
                os.replace(temporary,p)
        raise
    finally:
        for p in staged.values():p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return result


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument('--application',required=True)
    p.add_argument('--source-root',default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
    p.add_argument('--dry-run',action='store_true')
    args=p.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(install(args.application,args.source_root,args.dry_run),indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__':main()

# Original-catchment calibration maps and editable GIS

This workflow connects a completed annual-load calibration to its actual upstream catchments. It creates registered vector sources, complete numeric tables, per-pollutant atlases and ordinary saved Spatial reviews. Those same sources enter the maintained editable GIS exporter without a new model runner or a separate map application.

Every figure and vector attribute derives from an existing completed calibration report. The workflow keeps the original selected candidate, observation edition, catchment IDs, source periods, calibration/validation split, normalization scales and native support. It can add the already saved published-source-error supplement.

## Operator workflow

Open the completed calibration, choose **Prepare original catchment maps**, and select the existing source-error supplement if needed. The default includes the original selected candidate. Additional eligible candidate runs can be included for calibration units only.

The resulting retained map edition provides:

- A source layer for every selected candidate/pollutant pair, with complete original catchment polygons and numeric residual attributes.
- A PDF atlas and scalable SVG pages for each layer.
- A CSV containing all plotted and inspectable values, original source-record IDs and periods.
- A printable HTML index linking the complete files.
- Original calibration, selection, observation-edition and source-CSV copies, plus source-error JSON when selected.
- Direct opening of each registered vector in the existing Spatial review.
- A saved Spatial review with solid calibration outlines and dashed held-out selected-candidate outlines.
- A ready selection for the original editable GIS export, including scientific context attachments.

The native Spatial review uses its maintained outline and point-attribute inspection controls. Its ordinary vector overlays are not described as a shaded residual raster. The separate atlas provides signed residual figures with grayscale magnitude.

The model API is:

```python
from model import calibration_maps

maps = calibration_maps.prepare(
    workspace,
    actual_completed_calibration_id,
    uncertainty_id=actual_retained_source_error_id,  # optional
    candidate_run_ids=actual_eligible_run_ids,       # optional; defaults to selected
)
maps = calibration_maps.inspect(workspace, maps["id"])
link = calibration_maps.save_review(workspace, maps["id"], maps["layers"][0]["id"])
```

Only existing IDs are accepted. Selected run ordering follows the original ranking, so changing checkbox order does not create a second edition. The original selected candidate must remain in the chosen cohort.

Command line, from the application root:

```sh
python -m model.calibration_maps /path/to/original/workspace prepare EXISTING_CALIBRATION_ID
python -m model.calibration_maps /path/to/original/workspace prepare EXISTING_CALIBRATION_ID --uncertainty-id EXISTING_UNCERTAINTY_ID
python -m model.calibration_maps /path/to/original/workspace inspect RETURNED_MAP_ID
python -m model.calibration_maps /path/to/original/workspace save-review RETURNED_MAP_ID EXISTING_LAYER_ID
```

Repeat `--candidate-run-id` for an explicit cohort, including the originally selected run. The action uses completed saved prediction rows; it does not execute InVEST or fit a new estimator.

## Original geometry and coordinate systems

The original calibration plan identifies its source collection, vector source, native layer, property filter and catchment identity field. The workflow reopens that exact retained source through `Workspace.source_file`, which verifies original bytes, hashes and companion relationships. Its primary body must match the catchment source recorded in the original calibration spatial grouping.

The original catchment identity field must remain unique and non-null. Every required calibration catchment must be present. A valid Polygon or MultiPolygon is required; invalid geometry receives an explicit exception rather than an automatic repair.

The maintained `rasters.vector_geometry` reader handles the original native vector source, including its gzip path support. All polygon components and interior rings remain present.

Two coordinate systems serve different purposes:

| Product | Coordinates |
| --- | --- |
| Registered GeoJSON | EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude, transformed from the original source with explicit x/y axis order |
| Atlas and saved review | The originally selected candidate's retained projected model-grid CRS in metres |
| Source provenance | Original source WKT, output CRS, actual atlas CRS and source body/companions |

The atlas projection comes from the original saved model grid; it is not an assumed statewide projection. Reprojection is checked for valid finite geometry. There is no union, simplification, clipping, rasterization or replacement catchment delineation.

## What one feature means

One feature represents one original catchment/pollutant reference unit for one selected completed candidate. The feature ID binds the original run ID and unit ID. The original catchment ID, source feature ID, station IDs, candidate/profile identity, parameter and native units remain scalar or JSON-text attributes.

The physical quantities are:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `observed_annual_mass` | Original saved time-weighted annual reference for this catchment/pollutant |
| `native_annual_mass` | Retained completed native catchment load |
| `delivered_external_annual_mass` | Original explicitly supplied delivered external load |
| `predicted_annual_mass` | The quantity used by the original calibration, including that external load |
| `residual` | Predicted annual load minus original annual reference |
| `absolute_residual` | Magnitude of that signed residual |
| `relative_residual_percent` | 100 × residual / reference, only when the original reference is positive |
| `normalized_residual` | Residual divided by the original retained pollutant normalization scale |

Nitrogen and phosphorus retain kg/year. Sediment retains metric tonnes/year. Each source layer and each atlas is specific to one pollutant. No cross-pollutant mass sum is supplied.

The CSV and vector fields retain original source-record IDs, weighted source periods, methods, qualifiers and uncertainty details. The CSV uses the existing operator spreadsheet convention: text beginning with a formula-control prefix receives a leading apostrophe, while numeric quantities, including negative residuals, remain numeric. Exact text stays unchanged in JSON and GeoJSON. JSON-text attributes preserve lists and structured source details without losing their meaning in GeoPackage field conversion. `provenance.json` also keeps the complete original reference units and prediction rows.

## Native support and held-out observations

The workflow uses the original comparison's whole-catchment support result. Included values preserve valid-cell, structural-stream-omission and unexpected-missing-cell counts. Native calculations and stream-mask rules remain those of the saved original comparison.

An eligible calibration candidate must have complete calibration support. If that historical invariant is absent, preparation raises a concrete error rather than manufacturing a residual.

The original selected candidate can have incomplete held-out native support. Such features remain in the map with their original reference, partition and issues, while predicted/native/residual values remain null. They are never rendered as zero errors. White fill with an unavailable residual label distinguishes missing support from a numerical zero, and the complete table states coverage explicitly.

Additional candidate layers include calibration units only. They do not introduce challenger rankings or maps on held-out observations. The original full report is retained as an exact source attachment.

## Nested catchments and atlas reading

Catchments can share upstream land or contain one another. They remain separate features. Their source loads and residuals describe different original upstream areas and must not be added as independent regional totals.

The atlas avoids a last-feature-wins rasterization. Each panel draws one complete original catchment, including all components and holes. Nested areas therefore remain readable and do not obscure one another.

Every panel contains its original catchment ID, calibration or validation role, observed/predicted annual loads, native/external contributions, signed residual and source-reference band when selected. Solid panel frames denote calibration units; dashed frames denote held-out evaluation of the original selected candidate.

The SVG page reports each panel's exact projected bounding span in kilometres. Panels have individual extents; area comparisons should use the retained geometry and spans rather than apparent panel size. The PDF repeats the individual-extent interpretation. The atlas follows the original projected grid; it does not claim a true-north azimuth from an uncomputed convergence correction.

Grayscale encodes absolute residual magnitude. The numeric signed residual supplies direction. Light gray corresponds to zero magnitude and darker fill to larger magnitude. White/unfilled polygons have unavailable residuals, which are explicitly labeled. The maximum absolute residual for each pollutant is computed over the chosen saved candidates and applied consistently to that pollutant's atlases. This is a display scale, not a new calibration objective or probabilistic confidence measure.

PDFs use the existing Matplotlib runtime; SVG pages are created directly from the original projected coordinates. Original geometry and full precision attributes remain in GeoJSON independently of display coordinates. Matplotlib metadata excludes creation timestamps so interrupted reruns do not generate artificial scientific editions.

## Optional source-error bands

A source-error selection must be an existing `calibration-uncertainties` item for the same exact calibration. Its original dependency validator verifies the report, plan, observations and source CSV.

The reference endpoints come directly from its saved `reference_units`:

- `reference_lower` and `reference_upper` retain the original per-unit sensitivity region.
- `minimum_residual` equals the fixed predicted load minus the upper reference.
- `maximum_residual` equals the fixed predicted load minus the lower reference.
- `standard_errors`, `source_error_state` and missing source-record IDs retain coverage and selected multiplier.

Missing errors remain uncovered, and an unselected supplement stays explicitly unselected. The map workflow does not recalculate source error, change normalization or create an uncertainty distribution. See `model/CALIBRATION_UNCERTAINTY.md` for the exact shared-source sensitivity interpretation.

## Source registration and existing GIS export

The generated manifest uses the original `upstate.sources/v1` interface and is admitted through `Workspace.import_sources`. Each vector entry identifies its calibration, run, profile, parameter, native units and signed residual direction. It is labeled as derived calibration residual geometry rather than a new observation acquisition.

The generated source collection becomes available immediately through `SpatialReview.catalog`. Its original catalog ID is saved in each layer's `spatial_selection`. The same vector supports original property filtering and numeric point inspection.

Each layer and its context document share a `gis_context_group`. The context document sets `gis_required_context: true`, allowing the existing editable GIS request to include complete reference/atlas attachments automatically when a user selects one residual layer.

The returned `gis_selection` is directly compatible with:

```python
from model import gis_workspace
exported = gis_workspace.export(workspace, maps["gis_selection"])
```

The existing operator action `gis.project.export` accepts that selection directly as its payload. It produces the existing editable QGIS/GeoPackage package, complete source layers and accompanying original scientific records. No alternate GIS exporter is introduced.

Source-only GIS handovers require a display CRS. The prepared selection supplies the actual original model-grid CRS explicitly. Vector attributes retain their ordinary GIS field meanings and remain editable in the original received-then-adopted edition workflow.

## Saved geographic review and reopen behavior

`save_review` calls the maintained `SpatialReview.save` API with:

- The exact registered residual source as reference.
- Its actual projected catchment bounds.
- Single mode with no invented raster primary/comparison.
- Separate exact `partition` property filters for calibration and held-out observations.
- Solid and dashed outlines, respectively.
- Original scientific interpretation and the retained calibration map ID in the notes.

The original Spatial review saves its own immutable source bindings and ID. A separate immutable `calibration-map-reviews` linkage records:

```text
map_id, layer_id, review_id, source_collection_id, source_id
```

This preserves reopened discovery without mutating the immutable map result. The operator can list links matching `map_id` and open the original saved review through its existing spatial item controls.

## Artifacts, validation and interruption recovery

A completed map result is stored in `calibration-maps/<id>.json`. Files live under `calibration-map-exports/<selection_id>/`, where the selection binds the original report, plan, source edition, candidate cohort and optional error supplement.

A verified existing result reopens directly. PDF and complete-layer checkpoints retain byte counts and hashes so interruption does not force repetition of already completed native atlas rendering. Source JSON/CSV/SVG files use immutable atomic writes. The original source importer retains its content-addressed behavior, so a retry does not duplicate an identical source edition.

`inspect` checks:

- Original completed calibration, plan, observation edition and source CSV.
- Original optional source-error supplement.
- Exact map selection and artifact directory.
- Every exported file's retained byte count and SHA-256.
- Registered derived source bodies and companions.
- Original observation catchment body identity.

It uses retained metadata/file validation and does not need to rerun model outputs or render figures. The application restore hook can use it when adopting a saved workspace.

The result exposes full layer IDs, source collection/entry IDs, native model/profile IDs, row counts by partition, incomplete support counts, file descriptors, exact source selection, original coordinate systems and the ready GIS selection. Complete original files accompany the human-readable atlas and tables.

## Runtime and scientific dependencies

Preparation uses the application's maintained Fiona, Shapely, PyProj and Matplotlib runtime. The module imports those libraries only for actual geometry/rendering work. Readback uses the original stdlib/file validation and retained source APIs.

Dependencies remain the current `model.common`, `model.calibration_uncertainty`, `model.rasters`, `model.spatial`, Workspace and existing editable GIS modules. The workflow preserves the current observation-ingest owner's point/daily context improvements; it changes no observation admission or annual-load comparison arithmetic.

The exported residuals are interpreted within the same original source period, native model vintage, catchment support, explicit external-load choices and model-process limitations as the completed calibration. Geographic presentation makes those actual results easier to inspect and deliver while preserving their original scientific identity.

def _json(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                      allow_nan=False)


def _number(value, name, *, minimum=None, positive=False):
    return finite(value, name, minimum=minimum, positive=positive)


def _same(a, b, label):
    if digest(a) != digest(b):
        raise ValueError(label + " differs from the retained original calibration")


def _text(value):
    return html.escape(str(value), quote=True)


def _display(value):
    if value is None:
        return "unavailable"
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return format(value, ".7g")
    return str(value)


def _csv_cell(value):
    # Match the existing operator's spreadsheet text-cell convention. Numeric
    # signed residuals remain numeric; complete originals remain in JSON.
    if isinstance(value, str) and value[:1] in ("=", "+", "-", "@", "\t", "\r"):
        return "'" + value
    return "" if value is None else value


def _csv(rows):
    out = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.DictWriter(out, fieldnames=FIELDS, lineterminator="\n", extrasaction="raise")
    writer.writeheader()
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow({key: _csv_cell(row.get(key)) for key in FIELDS})
    return out.getvalue().encode("utf-8")


def _selection(workspace, calibration_id, uncertainty_id, candidate_run_ids):
    report, plan, observed = uncertainty._retained(workspace, identifier(calibration_id))
    by_run = {row["run_id"]: row for row in report["ranked_candidates"]}
    ids = [report["selected_run_id"]] if candidate_run_ids is None else list(candidate_run_ids)
    if (not ids or any(not isinstance(key, str) for key in ids)
            or len(set(ids)) != len(ids) or set(ids) - set(by_run)):
        raise ValueError("Choose each eligible completed calibration candidate at most once")
    if report["selected_run_id"] not in ids:
        raise ValueError("Retain the originally selected candidate in the geographic review")
    # Stable original rank order, regardless of checkbox order.
    ids = [row["run_id"] for row in report["ranked_candidates"] if row["run_id"] in ids]
    detail = None
    if uncertainty_id is not None:
        detail = uncertainty.inspect(workspace, identifier(uncertainty_id))
        if detail["calibration_id"] != report["id"]:
            raise ValueError("Select the source-error supplement for this exact calibration")
    selected = {
        "version": VERSION, "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
        "calibration_id": report["id"], "plan_id": plan["id"],
        "uncertainty_id": detail["id"] if detail else None,
        "candidate_run_ids": ids, "selected_run_id": report["selected_run_id"],
        "catchments": plan["selection"]["catchments"],
        "observation_id": observed["id"],
        "reference_units_sha256": digest(plan["units"]),
        "prediction_rows_sha256": digest(report["prediction_rows"]),
        "output_coordinates": "EPSG:4326", "atlas_coordinates": "original selected model grid",
        "validation_scope": "originally selected candidate only",
    }
    return selected, report, plan, observed, detail


def _geometry(workspace, selection, plan, report):
    from pyproj import CRS, Transformer
    from shapely.geometry import mapping
    from shapely.ops import transform
    from . import rasters

    chosen = selection["catchments"]
    source, entry = workspace.source_file(chosen["source_collection_id"], chosen["source_id"])
    if entry["kind"] != "vector":
        raise ValueError("The retained observation catchment source is not a vector")
    original = plan["spatial_groups"]["source"]
    if entry["body"]["sha256"] != original["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original calibration catchment source edition changed")
    features, source_crs = rasters.vector_geometry(
        source, layer=chosen.get("layer") or entry.get("layer"), where=chosen.get("where"))
    needed = {unit["catchment_id"] for unit in plan["units"]}
    index = {}
    field = chosen["id_field"]
    for feature in features:
        key = feature["properties"].get(field)
        if key is None or str(key) in index:
            raise ValueError("The original selected catchment identity must remain unique and non-null")
        index[str(key)] = feature
    missing = sorted(needed - set(index))
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("Original calibration catchments are absent: " + ", ".join(missing))
    selected = next(row for row in report["ranked_candidates"]
                    if row["run_id"] == report["selected_run_id"])
    grid = workspace.get_grid(selected["grid_id"])
    atlas_crs = CRS.from_user_input(grid["grid"]["crs"])
    if (not atlas_crs.is_projected
            or any(abs(axis.unit_conversion_factor - 1) > 1e-12 for axis in atlas_crs.axis_info[:2])):
        raise ValueError("The saved native atlas grid must use projected metres")
    to_geo = Transformer.from_crs(source_crs, "EPSG:4326", always_xy=True)
    to_atlas = Transformer.from_crs(source_crs, atlas_crs, always_xy=True)
    result = {}
    for key in sorted(needed):
        feature = index[key]
        geometry = feature["geometry"]
        if geometry.geom_type not in ("Polygon", "MultiPolygon") or geometry.is_empty or not geometry.is_valid:
            raise ValueError("A retained calibration catchment is not a valid original polygon")
        geographic = transform(to_geo.transform, geometry)
        atlas = transform(to_atlas.transform, geometry)
        if (not geographic.is_valid or not atlas.is_valid
                or not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (*geographic.bounds, *atlas.bounds))
                or atlas.area <= 0):
            raise ValueError("Original catchment reprojection produced invalid display geometry")
        result[key] = {
            "feature_id": feature["id"], "properties": feature["properties"],
            "geographic": mapping(geographic), "atlas": atlas,
        }
    bounds = [min(row["atlas"].bounds[0] for row in result.values()),
              min(row["atlas"].bounds[1] for row in result.values()),
              max(row["atlas"].bounds[2] for row in result.values()),
              max(row["atlas"].bounds[3] for row in result.values())]
    return result, {
        "selection": chosen, "uri": entry["uri"], "vintage": entry["vintage"],
        "body": entry["body"], "companions": entry.get("companions", []),
        "source_crs": CRS.from_user_input(source_crs).to_wkt(),
        "output_crs": "EPSG:4326", "atlas_crs": atlas_crs.to_wkt(),
        "atlas_crs_name": atlas_crs.to_string(), "atlas_bounds": bounds,
        "geometry_policy": "Original complete polygon parts and rings; projection only, no rasterization, union, clipping or simplification.",
    }


def _rows(report, plan, observed, detail, geometry, selected_runs):
    observations = {row["id"]: row for row in observed["rows"]}
    refs = {row["id"]: row for row in plan["units"]}
    bands = {row["unit_id"]: row for row in detail["reference_units"]} if detail else {}
    prediction = {}
    for row in report["prediction_rows"]:
        key = (row["run_id"], row["unit_id"])
        if key in prediction:
            raise ValueError("The original calibration repeats a native prediction identity")
        prediction[key] = row
    groups = []
    for candidate in report["ranked_candidates"]:
        if candidate["run_id"] not in selected_runs:
            continue
        for parameter in report["objective"]:
            values = []
            for unit in refs.values():
                if unit["parameter"] != parameter:
                    continue
                if candidate["run_id"] != report["selected_run_id"] and unit["partition"] != "calibration":
                    continue
                native = prediction.get((candidate["run_id"], unit["id"]))
                included = bool(native and native.get("included"))
                if unit["partition"] == "calibration" and not included:
                    raise ValueError("An eligible candidate lacks the original complete calibration support")
                source_rows = [observations[key] for key in unit["observation_record_ids"]]
                expected = _number(unit["observed_annual_mass"], "Original annual reference", minimum=0)
                predicted = (_number(native["predicted_annual_mass"], "Native compared annual load", minimum=0)
                             if included else None)
                residual = predicted - expected if included else None
                scale = _number(report["normalization"][parameter]["value"], "Original normalization", positive=True)
                band = bands.get(unit["id"])
                lower, upper = (band.get("lower_reference"), band.get("upper_reference")) if band else (None, None)
                support = native.get("native_support", {}) if native else {}
                row = {
                    "feature_id": digest({"run_id": candidate["run_id"], "unit_id": unit["id"]}),
                    "unit_id": unit["id"], "catchment_id": unit["catchment_id"],
                    "source_feature_id": geometry[unit["catchment_id"]]["feature_id"],
                    "station_ids": _json(unit["station_ids"]), "run_id": candidate["run_id"],
                    "profile_id": candidate["profile_id"], "candidate_title": candidate.get("title") or candidate["profile_id"],
                    "parameter": parameter, "units": unit["units"], "partition": unit["partition"],
                    "native_coverage": "complete" if included else "incomplete",
                    "observed_annual_mass": expected,
                    "native_annual_mass": native.get("native_annual_mass") if included else None,
                    "delivered_external_annual_mass": unit["delivered_external_annual_mass"],
                    "predicted_annual_mass": predicted, "residual": residual,
                    "absolute_residual": abs(residual) if residual is not None else None,
                    "relative_residual_percent": 100 * residual / expected if residual is not None and expected > 0 else None,
                    "normalization_scale": scale,
                    "normalized_residual": residual / scale if residual is not None else None,
                    "reference_lower": lower, "reference_upper": upper,
                    "minimum_residual": predicted - upper if included and upper is not None else None,
                    "maximum_residual": predicted - lower if included and lower is not None else None,
                    "source_error_state": band["state"] if band else "no_supplement_selected",
                    "missing_error_records": _json(band["missing_record_ids"]) if band else None,
                    "standard_errors": detail["standard_errors"] if detail else None,
                    "valid_cells": support.get("valid_cells"),
                    "structural_stream_omission_cells": support.get("structural_stream_omission_cells"),
                    "unexpected_missing_cells": support.get("unexpected_missing_cells"),
                    "source_record_ids": _json(unit["observation_record_ids"]),
                    "source_periods": _json(unit["periods"]), "source_methods": _json(unit["reference_methods"]),
                    "source_qualifiers": _json([row.get("qualifier") for row in source_rows]),
                    "source_uncertainty": _json(unit["reference_uncertainty"]),
                    "native_support_issues": _json(native.get("issues", []) if native else ["Original comparison has no retained prediction row"]),
                }
                if unit["units"] != UNITS[parameter]:
                    raise ValueError("Original calibration pollutant units differ")
                for name, value in row.items():
                    if isinstance(value, float) and not math.isfinite(value):
                        raise ValueError("A derived map attribute exceeds finite range: " + name)
                values.append(row)
            if values:
                groups.append({"run_id": candidate["run_id"], "profile_id": candidate["profile_id"],
                               "title": candidate.get("title") or candidate["profile_id"],
                               "selected_models": candidate.get("selected_models"), "parameter": parameter,
                               "units": UNITS[parameter], "rows": values})
    return groups


def _parts(geometry):
    return [geometry] if geometry.geom_type == "Polygon" else list(geometry.geoms)


def _svg_path(geometry, bounds, box):
    left, bottom, right, top = bounds
    x, y, width, height = box
    scale = min(width / max(right - left, 1e-12), height / max(top - bottom, 1e-12))
    ox, oy = x + (width - (right - left) * scale) / 2, y + (height - (top - bottom) * scale) / 2
    path = []
    for polygon in _parts(geometry):
        for ring in [polygon.exterior, *polygon.interiors]:
            coords = list(ring.coords)
            if not coords:
                continue
            converted = [(ox + (point[0] - left) * scale, oy + (top - point[1]) * scale) for point in coords]
            path.append("M " + " L ".join(format(px, ".7f") + "," + format(py, ".7f") for px, py in converted) + " Z")
    return " ".join(path)


def _shade(value, cap):
    if value is None:
        return "#ffffff"
    fraction = min(abs(value) / cap, 1) if cap > 0 else 0
    gray = round(244 - 135 * fraction)
    return "#" + format(gray, "02x") * 3

        ]

    parts.extend([

def _pdf_atlas(path, group, geometry, context, cap):
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use("Agg")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    from matplotlib.backends.backend_pdf import PdfPages
    from matplotlib.path import Path as PlotPath
    from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch

def _page_html(layers, interpretation):
    sections = []

        pages = "".join('<figure><img src="' + _text(item["path"]) + '" alt="' +
                        _text(layer["title"] + " complete original catchments") + '"/></figure>'

                           for name, label in (("geojson", "Original geometry and residual attributes"),

        sections.append("<section><h2>" + _text(layer["title"]) + "</h2><p>" + links + "</p>" + pages + "</section>")

            '<style>body{font:15px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#202020;background:white;max-width:1100px;margin:auto;padding:32px}'

def prepare(workspace, calibration_id, *, uncertainty_id=None, candidate_run_ids=None):
    """Materialize source-bound original-catchment layers and residual atlases."""
    selection, report, plan, observed, detail = _selection(
        workspace, calibration_id, uncertainty_id, candidate_run_ids)
    selection_id = digest(selection)
    directory = workspace.root / "calibration-map-exports" / selection_id
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with held(directory / ".maps.lock", blocking=False):
        pointer = directory / "result.json"
        if pointer.exists():
            previous = read_json(pointer)
            return inspect(workspace, previous["map_id"])
        atomic_json(directory / "selection.json", selection, immutable=True)
        geometry, context = _geometry(workspace, selection, plan, report)
        groups = _rows(report, plan, observed, detail, geometry, selection["candidate_run_ids"])
        caps = {parameter: max((abs(row["residual"]) for group in groups if group["parameter"] == parameter
                                for row in group["rows"] if row["residual"] is not None), default=0.0)
                for parameter in report["objective"]}
        provenance = {
            "schema": "upstate.calibration-map-provenance/v1", "selection": selection,
            "original_catchments": context, "observation_original": observed["original"],
            "observation_metadata": observed["metadata"], "source_vintages": report["source_vintages"],
            "original_catchment_properties": {key: row["properties"] for key, row in geometry.items()},
            "reference_units": plan["units"], "prediction_rows": report["prediction_rows"],
            "objective": report["objective"], "normalization": report["normalization"],
            "temporal_method": report["temporal_method"], "comparison_ids": report["comparison_ids"],
            "source_error_interpretation": detail["interpretation"] if detail else None,
            "interpretation": MEANING, "absolute_residual_display_caps": caps,
        }
        atomic_json(directory / "provenance.json", provenance, immutable=True)
        originals = {
            "original-calibration.json": workspace.root / "calibrations" / (report["id"] + ".json"),
            "original-calibration-plan.json": workspace.root / "calibration-plans" / (plan["id"] + ".json"),
            "original-observation-edition.json": workspace.root / "observations" / (observed["id"] + ".json"),
            "original-observations.csv": workspace.root / observed["original"]["object"],
        }
        if detail:
            originals["original-source-uncertainty.json"] = workspace.root / "calibration-uncertainties" / (detail["id"] + ".json")
        for name, path in originals.items():
            atomic_bytes(directory / name, path.read_bytes(), immutable=True)
        layers, entries = [], []
        for group in groups:
            key = digest({"run_id": group["run_id"], "parameter": group["parameter"]})
            stem = group["parameter"] + "-" + group["run_id"]
            features = [{"type": "Feature", "id": row["feature_id"],
                         "properties": row, "geometry": geometry[row["catchment_id"]]["geographic"]}
                        for row in group["rows"]]
            geojson_path = directory / (stem + ".geojson")
            atomic_json(geojson_path, {"type": "FeatureCollection",
                                      "name": stem, "features": features}, immutable=True)
            csv_path = directory / (stem + ".csv")
            atomic_bytes(csv_path, _csv(group["rows"]), immutable=True)
            pdf_path = directory / (stem + ".pdf")
            checkpoint_path = directory / (stem + "-completed.json")
            if checkpoint_path.exists():
                checkpoint = read_json(checkpoint_path)
                if checkpoint.get("selection_id") != selection_id or checkpoint.get("layer_id") != key:
                    raise ValueError("A retained atlas checkpoint belongs to another scientific selection")
                for artifact in checkpoint["files"]:
                    verify_file(directory, artifact)
            else:
                _pdf_atlas(pdf_path, group, geometry, context, caps[group["parameter"]])
            page_count = (len(group["rows"]) + 5) // 6
            svg_pages = []
            for start in range(0, len(group["rows"]), 6):
                page = start // 6 + 1
                path = directory / (stem + "-page-" + str(page) + ".svg")
                atomic_bytes(path, _atlas_svg(group, group["rows"][start:start+6], geometry, context,
                                              caps[group["parameter"]], page, page_count), immutable=True)
                svg_pages.append(describe_file(directory, path))
            complete_files = [describe_file(directory, path) for path in (geojson_path, csv_path, pdf_path)] + svg_pages
            atomic_json(checkpoint_path, {"selection_id": selection_id, "layer_id": key,
                                         "files": complete_files}, immutable=True)
            source_id = "calibration-" + key
            layer_title = group["parameter"].title() + " residuals · " + group["title"] + " · " + group["units"]
            count = Counter(row["partition"] for row in group["rows"])
            layers.append({
                "id": key, "source_id": source_id, "run_id": group["run_id"], "profile_id": group["profile_id"],
                "selected_models": group["selected_models"], "parameter": group["parameter"], "units": group["units"],
                "title": layer_title, "rows": len(group["rows"]),
                "calibration_rows": count["calibration"], "validation_rows": count["validation"],
                "incomplete_native_rows": sum(row["native_coverage"] != "complete" for row in group["rows"]),
                "geojson": describe_file(directory, geojson_path), "csv": describe_file(directory, csv_path),
                "pdf": describe_file(directory, pdf_path), "svg_pages": svg_pages,
                "absolute_residual_display_cap": caps[group["parameter"]],
            })
            entries.append({
                "id": source_id, "kind": "vector", "role": "CALIBRATION_RESIDUAL_CATCHMENTS",
                "title": layer_title, **describe_file(directory, geojson_path),
                "uri": "urn:upstate:calibration:" + report["id"] + ":residuals:" + key,
                "vintage": "Original retained calibration " + report["id"],
                "source_crs": "EPSG:4326", "units": group["units"], "id_field": "feature_id",
                "purpose": "context", "metric": "calibration_residual_" + group["parameter"],

        context_names.extend(item["path"] for layer in layers for item in layer["svg_pages"])
        entries.append({
            "id": "calibration-context-" + selection_id, "kind": "document",
            "title": "Original calibration results, reference rows and residual atlas",
            "path": "index.html", "sha256": describe_file(directory, directory / "index.html")["sha256"],
            "companions": [describe_file(directory, directory / name) for name in context_names if name != "index.html"],
            "uri": "urn:upstate:calibration:" + report["id"],
            "vintage": "Original retained calibration " + report["id"],
            "gis_context_group": selection_id, "gis_required_context": True,
        })
        manifest = {"schema": "upstate.sources/v1", "title": report["title"] + " · original catchment residuals",
                    "entries": entries, "scope": {"calibration_maps": selection},
                    "notes": [MEANING, "Vector attributes retain numeric fields; nested polygons remain separate original catchments."]}
        atomic_json(directory / "source-manifest.json", manifest, immutable=True)
        collection = workspace.import_sources(directory / "source-manifest.json")

                "project_crs": context["atlas_crs_name"], "include_grid": False,
                "notes": [MEANING, "The per-pollutant atlas supplies signed residual figures; original vector sources retain complete editable attributes."],
            },
        })

def inspect(workspace, map_id):
    """Verify maps, original scientific dependencies and registered source bodies."""
    result = workspace._get(RESULT_KIND, identifier(map_id))
    if result.get("version") != VERSION or result.get("workspace_id") != workspace.project["id"]:
        raise ValueError("Select this workspace's retained calibration map edition")
    selected, report, plan, observed, detail = _selection(
        workspace, result["calibration_id"], result["uncertainty_id"], result["selection"]["candidate_run_ids"])
    _same(selected, result["selection"], "Calibration map selection")
    if digest(selected) != result["selection_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The retained calibration map selection ID changed")
    directory = workspace.root / "calibration-map-exports" / result["selection_id"]
    if result["directory"] != directory.relative_to(workspace.root).as_posix():
        raise ValueError("Calibration map artifact directory differs")
    for file in result["files"]:
        verify_file(directory, file)
    collection = workspace._get("sources", result["source_collection_id"])
    for entry in collection["entries"]:
        workspace.source_file(collection["id"], entry["id"])
    catchment = plan["selection"]["catchments"]
    _, original = workspace.source_file(catchment["source_collection_id"], catchment["source_id"])
    if original["body"]["sha256"] != result["original_catchments"]["body"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("The original calibration catchment source changed")
    return result


def save_review(workspace, map_id, layer_id):
    """Save an ordinary source-bound spatial review with exact holdout overlays."""
    from .spatial import SpatialReview
    result = inspect(workspace, map_id)
    found = [layer for layer in result["layers"] if layer["id"] == layer_id]
    if len(found) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Choose a retained residual map layer")
    layer = found[0]
    selection = layer["spatial_selection"]
    overlays = []
    for partition, style, count in (("calibration", "solid", layer["calibration_rows"]),
                                    ("validation", "dash", layer["validation_rows"])):
        if count:
            overlays.append({"selection": {**selection, "where": {"partition": partition}},
                             "label": partition.title() + " · " + layer["parameter"] + " · " + layer["units"],
                             "visible": True, "style": style, "width": 1.25, "opacity": 1.0})
    review = SpatialReview(workspace).save({
        "title": layer["title"], "reference": selection, "view": layer["view"],
        "mode": "single", "primary": None, "comparison": None,
        "overlays": overlays, "markers": [], "notes": MEANING + "\nCalibration map edition " + result["id"],
    })
    return workspace._save("calibration-map-reviews", {
        "version": VERSION, "workspace_id": workspace.project["id"],
        "map_id": result["id"], "layer_id": layer["id"], "review_id": review["id"],
        "source_collection_id": result["source_collection_id"], "source_id": layer["source_id"],
    })


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("workspace")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)
    create = commands.add_parser("prepare")
    create.add_argument("calibration_id")
    create.add_argument("--uncertainty-id")
    create.add_argument("--candidate-run-id", action="append")
    show = commands.add_parser("inspect")
    show.add_argument("map_id")
    review = commands.add_parser("save-review")
    review.add_argument("map_id"); review.add_argument("layer_id")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    from .workspace import Workspace
    workspace = Workspace(args.workspace)
    if args.action == "prepare":
        result = prepare(workspace, args.calibration_id, uncertainty_id=args.uncertainty_id,
                         candidate_run_ids=args.candidate_run_id)
    elif args.action == "save-review":
        result = save_review(workspace, args.map_id, args.layer_id)
    else:
        result = inspect(workspace, args.map_id)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
